==Ingredients==
*1⅜ sticks (175 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] / 6.2 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], plus extra for greasing
*¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (175 g / 6.2 oz) [[Cookbook:Superfine Sugar|superfine sugar]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]] extract
*3 medium [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
*1¼ cups (175 g / 6.2 oz) [[Cookbook:Self-rising Flour|self-raising flour]]
*1 tsp [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
*6 [[Cookbook:Raspberry|raspberries]]
*[[Cookbook:Powdered Sugar|Powdered sugar]], for dusting
==Procedure==
#Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to {{Convert|190|C|F}}. Grease and line a {{Convert|20|cm|in|abbr=on|adj=on}} round [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|cake tin]].
#[[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] the butter, sugar and vanilla in a mixing bowl, until soft and fluffy.
#Beat in the eggs, one at a time.
#[[Cookbook:Folding|Fold]] the flour and baking powder into the mixture to make a batter.
#[[Cookbook:Puréeing|Purée]] the raspberries in a [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]].
#Spoon the batter into the cake tin.
#Pour the raspberry puree over the batter, and swirl the mixture with a [[Cookbook:Skewer|skewer]] to create a rippled effect.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 20–25 minutes until a skewer inserted comes clean.
#Transfer the cake to the [[Cookbook:Cooling Rack|wire rack]] and leave it to cool completely.
#[[Cookbook:Dusting|Dust]] the cake with icing sugar.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to . Grease and line a  round cake tin.
Beat the butter, sugar and vanilla in a mixing bowl, until soft and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs, one at a time.
Fold the flour and baking powder into the mixture to make a batter.
Purée the raspberries in a blender.
Spoon the batter into the cake tin.
Pour the raspberry puree over the batter, and swirl the mixture with a skewer to create a rippled effect.
Bake for 20–25 minutes until a skewer inserted comes clean.
Transfer the cake to the wire rack and leave it to cool completely.
Dust the cake with icing sugar.
